# Vector coverage of the `schema`/`d7-validate` requirements

Scope: every non-deprecated requirement whose verification contains `schema` or `d7-validate` (ADR-0019 §9). **covered** = at least one reviewed valid vector names it in `reqs` and one reviewed invalid vector in `violates`; **derived** = umbrella of `coverage/implications.yaml` whose details are all covered or derived. Draft vectors are marked with `*` and do not count. The layer of a negative vector is `schema` (its entry schema reports the REQ, no mark), `rule` (rule layer of D7 validate per `oec/schema/tests/rule-layer.yaml`) or `R-1` (topic and Identification Link vectors). P2 exit gate (ROADMAP P2 exit 2 and 3): `spectool coverage -check -gate`.
